fact: The RBZ 2025 Annual Report says local PAPSS participation rose from banks beginning onboarding in January 2025 to six banks, and Zimbabwean banks processed 4,038 SADC-RTGS transactions worth ZAR3.51 billion in 2025.
title: Zimbabwe Cross-Border Payments: Remittances, SADC-RTGS, PAPSS and Digital Payment Infrastructure
